National Stock Exchange of India Limited

Dalal Street, Mumbai- 400001, India 
Scrip Code: 532440 
 
Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Sub:  Intimation of Schedule of Investor/ Analysts’ Earnings Conference Call on the 
Unaudited Financial Results of MPS Limited for the quarter and half year ended                      
30 September 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the Securities and 
Exchange Board of India ሺListing Obligations and Disclosure Requirementsሻ Regulations, 
2015, we wish to inform you that MPS Limited ሺthe “Company”ሻ is organizing an Earnings 
Conference Call for Investors/ Analysts on Wednesday, 04 November 2026 at 04:30 P.M. 
ሺISTሻ to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year 
ended 30 September 2026. 
 
The Conference Call Invite containing the details for participation in the aforesaid conference 
call is enclosed herewith. 
 
The invite is also available on the Company's website at:  
https://www.mpslimited.com/investors-overview/  
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
Yours Faithfully, 
For MPS Limited 
 
 
 
Piyush Jain 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Encl: As above 
 
 
PIYUSH 
JAIN
Digitally signed 
by PIYUSH JAIN

Invitation to Q2 & H1’FY27 Earnings Call 
Scheduled on  
 
Date: Wednesday, 04 November 2026 
 
Time: 04:30 PM 
Participants: 
Mr. Rahul Arora, Chairman and CEO, along with the senior management team of the Company, 
will be present to address the call 
 
 
You may join through the following link with DiamondPass™  No Wait Time 
 https://services.choruscall.in/DiamondPassRegistration/register?confirmationNumber=96804
95&linkSecurityString=560cccd5be 
 
Alternatively, you may join using following dial-in numbers* 
Universal Dial-In Numbers 
+91 22 6280 1410  
+91 22 7115 8311 
 
International Toll Free Numbers 
USA: 18667462133 
UK: 08081011573 
Singapore: 8001012045 
Hong Kong: 800964448 
 
*When using dial-in numbers mentioned above, please do so 10 minutes before the call scheduled 
to ensure that you are connected to your call in time.   
 
If invitees need any assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing 
“*” then “0” on your touch-tone phone. Invitees who wish to ask a question may press * and 1 on 
their touch-tone telephone. 
 
For more information, please log on to www.mpslimited.com or contact: 
Investor Relations Desk 
MPS Limited 
Email: investors@mpslimited.com
